generation.mode: single built-in imagegen edit with edit-target.png first and the canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.method: Repository-equivalent 36-bin luminance-gradient measurement on the 2560 px derived land canvas after the delivered water mask; magnitude floor 12.

rockLighting.method: Repository-equivalent first circular moment of strong (>=80) luminance gradients whose center and four orthogonal neighbours classify as rock on the 2560 px derived land canvas.

edgeBandsMethod: Median all-land luma in the repository's 16-176 px inward bands at final 2560 px scale, excluding cut water.

crown.method: Manual full-silhouette width census of 27 fully visible ordinary conifers across the source, including the visibly largest and smallest complete crowns, scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 4.8 cm/px.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: Manual visual estimate as fractions of non-water land.
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The broad open central and eastern meadow shelf counts as buildable; only the short fall banks and immediate incised channel margins count as steep.

waterMask.note: Opaque white water on transparent non-water. The trace includes the very dark north reach, pool, fall, inlet, shoreline wash, reflections, wet rock gaps, shallows and open sound.

refusalReasons: The generated land/water balance drifted materially: the repository-equivalent final land coverage is 77.95%, not the settled 64%.
The settled edge tones were not held: N/W/E measured 76.4/81.5/75.7 rather than 87.1/98.2/83.1.
The key-light and gradient-ratio metrics also changed from the settled values, so this is not a rock-lighting-only correction.
Although the numeric rock gate passes at 0.156262, several large inherited and generated rocks still read with pale upper facets by eye; visual flat-face conformity is not claimed.
